args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation incorrectly used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly
test suite (tests/test_money.py) to fail on half-way values such as
2.665, which should round to 2.66 under ROUND_HALF_EVEN, not 2.67.
Use Decimal's ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the documented behavior.

args.head: fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite the docstring (and FIN-212) specifying banker's rounding.
- Changed the `quantize` call to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so half-way values round to the nearest even cent (e.g., `2.665` → `2.66`, not `2.67`), fixing the `tests/test_money.py` nightly failures.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fin-212-bankers-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`): **passed**.
- Note: an unrelated flaky test (`tests/test_ledger.py::test_totals`) was seen on a main run and is not affected by this change.

Fixes the nightly build failure for tests/test_money.py per FIN-212.
